proposedRow.phaseLocalRationale: The existing recipe specification compiler and AC-07 cover the typed semantic-compilation submeaning: exact versioned YAML/JSON production specification, declared schema and source references produce a typed normalized semantic graph with input/schema/compiler-contract provenance and stable semantic fingerprint, with invalid or unauthorized input causing no project, asset, job or external effect. The source phrase also requires schema migrations. PDP-0 does not define the migration product outcome, version-transition boundary, provenance, or incompatible/unknown behavior, so this row remains incomplete until the source owner defines that meaning. PDP-1 owns migration mechanics after PDP-0 intent is defined.
